patch.objective: Inbound and outbound resolver endpoints, and when each is required

sources.cite: AWS Certified Advanced Networking - Specialty (ANS-C01) exam guide: Network Design 30%, Network Implementation 26%, Network Management and Operation 20%, Network Security, Compliance, and Governance 24%
sources.note: Domain 1 page read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17: 'This domain accounts for 30% of the exam content'; Task 1.3 skill 'Integrating load balancers with existing application deployments'; knowledge of 'Configuration options for load balancer target groups'. The other domains' weights and wording are the course seed's (backend/supabase/seed/tracks/aws.ts); their pages were not re-read. (read for this round by an earlier pass on 2026-11-17)

sources.cite: AWS Certification, AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional certification page (current exam SAP-C03), and Tutorials Dojo, 'What's new with the AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional SAP-C03'
sources.note: Both read through summarizing fetches on 2026-11-17. The AWS page links the SAP-C03 exam guide and prep plan but shows no domains. The Tutorials Dojo page lists the five SAP-C03 domains (cloud-native architecture design and implementation; security, compliance, and governance; cost-optimized architecture design; resilience, migration, and business continuity; operational excellence and automation) and says SAP-C03 became generally available on November 17, 2026. The weights (25/25/15/15/20) and the objective wording are the course seed's; the official SAP-C03 guide was not read (to verify).

sources.cite: Amazon Route 53 Developer Guide, What is Amazon Route 53 Resolver?
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Quoted: 'Inbound Resolver endpoints allow DNS queries to your VPC from your on-premises network or another VPC'; 'Outbound Resolver endpoints allow DNS queries from your VPC to your on-premises network'; 'The on-premises DNS resolver has a forwarding rule that points queries to dev.example.com to an inbound endpoint'; VPC Resolver answers records in private hosted zones. That a private hosted zone answers only VPCs associated with it, and the endpoint's two-IP-addresses-in-two-Availability-Zones setup, are from memory of the Route 53 guide (to verify).
